scope: Read-only fixed Git objects. No source/ref mutation, Root launch, credentials, build or new runtime qualification.

consumer_absence.limited_to: These named joint consumer modules and the actual ui/session main parser, not a claim that all current Desktop features are absent.

        let mut command = Command::new(format!("/proc/self/fd/{}", program.as_raw_fd()));
        command
            .arg("--notes-root-bootstrap-stdin")
            .current_dir(&fresh.user)
            .env_clear()

            .env("PATH", "/usr/bin:/bin")

                fs::digest(
                    &inputs

                        .app_window
                        .with_file_name("trill-notes-recovery"),
                )?,
            )
            .stdin(Stdio::from(File::from(std::os::fd::OwnedFd::from(
                child_pair,
            ))))

peer_uid: inputs.uid,
        peer_gid: inputs.gid,
        timeout_ms: 5_000,
        lifetime_ms: inputs.lifetime_ms,
        issuer_record_profile: HostIssuerRecordProfile::TextRecovery,

if self.schema != "hepta.agentd.original_desktop_launch.v1"
            || self.profile != "notes_calculator_v1"
            || self.agent_id != agent_id
            || self.spawn_generation != spawn_generation
            || owner == 0
            || self.session.uid != owner
            || self.session.pid == 0

            || self.session.process_start_ticks == 0
